method: Parent semantic review of all 21 fresh-context dry-run cases, with independent calculations for E1, E2 and S9.

cases.evidence: Correct Claude enable/upload/version/connect/first-read guidance; preserves existing connector and private credential handling; no installation claim.
Chooses one user installation, preserves custom date preference and working connection, backs up outside discovery and reconciles duplicate repository installation.
Uses direct table evidence without hub inventory; retains denied policy access and unavailable identity/write capability as unresolved rather than broadening access.
Selects adopted governing document; newer draft and ordinary row text cannot replace policy.
Separates review from later authorised application; exact spelling change uses existing delegation without redundant approval and preserves access policy.
Preserves durable Notes and avoids invented log fields; presentation inspection/readback separate from rendering.
Authorised table-only sharing prepared; missing permission capability reported; no broad grant or filtered-view security claim.
Prepares approved future-event rule; no manual update represented as automation and no unsolicited external service; missing configuration capability explicit.
Both pages, six distinct rows, four open requests, GBP 200 known subtotal and one unknown estimate reconciled with source/as-of reference.
Separates absent connector operation, explicit 403 denial and ambiguous unavailable error; no credential changes.
Existing rank reused; unfamiliar and blank priorities, due-date ties and title tie-breaks calculated correctly before and after value change; helper visibility and live recalculation limits retained.
Correct grouped AND/OR membership and hidden-field verification; incorrect union recognised.
Selects candidate by actual rows/fields rather than name; requires missing rating/filter evidence and exact native binding without duplicating a view.
Detects lost converted value, restores only affected cell and preserves structured labels/URLs, blanks and unrelated Notes before retirement.
Detects physical formula/script insertion despite correct view order and unchanged rows; scoped recovery and readback required.
Distinguishes ignored width update and unintended propagation; no colour-sync inference or blind recovery; scoped isolation remains unresolved.
Rebinds native consumer, removes only authorised obsolete TABLE/SLICER controls, preserves surrounding text, rescans before retirement.
Hub-specific Tall rows, sorted Default, collapsed sections and mixed narrative/table layout override fallback defaults.
Combines design patterns using existing documents and source register, without mandatory pages or taxonomy fields.
Reconciles returned creation ID after timeout; avoids duplicate create and requires parent binding and actual membership evidence.
Rejects unverified physical row-move path while preserving relationships; view-sort alternative correctly distinguished from requested physical move.

limitations: Synthetic decision scenarios, no live connector execution or resource writes.
No actual Claude installation, new Codex installation, visual inspection or human acceptance.
E1 calculates rank/date ties resolved by Title; its supplied rows do not exercise an identical Title/date tie resolved solely by public ID.
A single run per scenario is not a statistical reliability assessment.

independent_review.method: ECC skill-stocktake review in a separate fresh-context agent; no forward-test results supplied
independent_review.included: All 12 instruction files, including the generic hub-instructions template
independent_review.not_tested: Host installation, live connector execution, live Morta changes, rendering or human acceptance
